narrative.overview: The playable map leads. Buildings use crisp Canvas 2D silhouettes, dark outlines, pale walls, and distinct coral, teal, blue, yellow, and mauve roofs.
dos: Do preserve gameplay, save compatibility, and recognizable building roles.
donts: Don't move click targets with animation.
